quality_check.description: A portrait-format hand-drawn scene on an aged parchment page shows a brass-and-brown spyglass thrust close to camera, held at the lower-right edge by a blue-cuffed hand. The dominant circular lens contains torn shelter fabric and a partly collapsed support frame. Outside the lens, the tropical beach shows bent palms, scattered branches, damaged cordage and storm debris, while a water-filled barrel and gathered fruit remain intact nearby.

Create one full 9:16 hand-drawn scene, never a reference sheet. The captain's same spyglass is close to camera, eyepiece facing the viewer and barrel pointing away into the topic-appropriate setting. Its circular lens dominates without swallowing the recognizable brass rim and brown barrel. Preserve the attached entry_identity's object design and the character_sheet's actual hand, blue coat cuff and proportions. Show one restrained ownership and agency cue at an edge, not the whole host or a floating anonymous telescope. Do not redesign the captain to match the world style.

Inside the lens place the first topic-specific clue in the attached style_reference's medium, palette and texture; outside it keep the established opening treatment. Follow episode direction for orientation, grip and the A/B seam. The lens is an explanatory window, not a microscope or supernatural proof. No eye/face behind the lens, bottle/pipe performance, text, labels, grid, UI, new emblems, extra limbs, 3D or photorealism. The eventual world keyframe must have neither host nor telescope.

EPISODE TOPIC: Could You Live Forever on a Desert Island?
EPISODE DIRECTION: Bright post-storm tropical beach camp: a blue-cuffed hand firmly holds the captain’s spyglass, barrel aimed away from the viewer. Through the lens, torn shelter fabric and a partly collapsed frame snap in the wind. Beyond it, bent palms, scattered branches, ripped cordage and storm debris trace the damage outward. Keep a full rain barrel and gathered fruit clearly intact nearby, creating an immediate visual contradiction between secure supplies and environmental danger.
